question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Mercurial
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2) i.e. "Tranquil".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mercurial: (चंचल)** - Characterized by rapid and unpredictable change in mood.
 
• **Trick: **The sound of **mercurial **and **squirrel** is almost the same. **Squirrel** is very energetic. 
 
 
• **Example**: His mercurial temperament made him difficult to work with.
 
 
 
• **Tranquil: (शांत)** - Free from disturbance; calm.
 
 
• **Example**: The hotel was tranquil and peaceful.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Tranquil".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Flippant: (उपेक्षा)** - Not showing a serious or respectful attitude.
 
• **Salacious: (अश्लील) **- (of writing, pictures, or talk) treating sexual matters in an indecent way.
 
• **Bereaved: (शोक संतप्त) **- Be deprived of a loved one through a profound absence, especially due to the loved one's death.
